notes.text: Rautenstrauch-Joest-Museum, Inventarbuch 8, page 195 (stable citation https://doi.org/10.11588/diglit.78032#0195). The printed headings are Nr., Gegenstand, Herkunft, Erwerbung and Bemerkungen. The entry is numbered 48526; its Gegenstand cell uses a ditto mark repeating 'Holzfigur' from 48525, and its Herkunft cell repeats 'Polynesien, Osterinsel'. The register wording is historic and does not establish present location. The HAI page states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the scan is preserved for source evidence only.
